independence_declaration.statement: I (qa-verifier) authored no implementation in the reviewed DG0 scope. The analysis and register are by transformation-analyst; the agent definitions, runner, guard, sandbox-run, prefreeze, gate tooling, CI and delivery records are by delivery-orchestrator. My only writes are test evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/qa/ and this record and its sidecars. I formed this verdict before reading any other round-13 review record, and I did not read them.

summary: FAIL on Low items only: no Critical, High or Medium finding in the QA scope. All required commands, the sandboxed prefreeze (10/10), the A24/A25 regression suite (94/94), 13 new independent cases, register integrity, agent-load evidence, feasibility and the live guard probe PASS. F-DG0-226, 227, 228, 229, 230 and 232 are CLOSED_VERIFIED. F-DG0-231 stays OPEN: agents.md:28 still says project,local, and the reviewer definitions prescribe git worktree add /tmp. New Low findings: F-DG0-233 (meta.cwd is not bound to the transcript, a residual of F-DG0-230) and F-DG0-234 (the config scan never reports removals, and the D-026 stub rule hides truncation of ignored configuration). All three are non-mandatory, and I'd accept each as an observation. The verdict is FAIL only because checks QA13-K06 and QA13-K16 failed, and the protocol requires every check to pass for PASS.
